setup: Build each case with `uv run --python 3.12 evals/fixtures/make_repo.py <fixture> <case>`; grade with `uv run --python 3.12 evals/check_state.py <fixture> <outputs>/final_message.txt`. Every prompt gets this suffix: This is a disposable eval fixture. The session's work is in {{repo}}; touch no other repository. GitHub is faked by the shim in {{bin}}: run every gh command with PATH="{{bin}}:$PATH". When done, save the exact final message you would print to the user to {{outputs}}/final_message.txt.

evals.name: now-feature-branch-no-pr
evals.prompt: usage is about to run out, eject now. commit and push everything, and if there's no PR yet open a draft one titled `[ejected session]: <short desc>`.
evals.expected_output: Dirty and untracked work on feature/login committed as WIP and pushed, one draft PR with the eject title, then a standalone handoff paragraph.

evals.name: now-dirty-default-branch
evals.prompt: running out of usage — eject the session now. commit, push, draft PR `[ejected session]: <short desc>` if there isn't one.
evals.expected_output: Changes on main move to an eject/ branch that is pushed with a draft PR; origin main is untouched.

evals.name: soft-open-pr-in-flight
evals.prompt: I'm close to my usage limit. Wrap up the session safely: commit all changes, update the PR that's in flight, and stop work.
evals.expected_output: Unpushed commit and dirty test file pushed to feature/cache, PR #7 updated with a comment, no new PR, then a handoff paragraph.

evals.name: now-secret-file-and-failing-hook
evals.prompt: eject now, usage nearly gone. commit + push everything and open a draft PR `[ejected session]: <short desc>` if none exists.
evals.expected_output: Billing change committed past the failing lint hook and pushed, config/secrets.env left out, draft PR body notes --no-verify.
